newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Three groups to bid at Cerj auction - paper.
newsitem.headline: Three groups to bid at Cerj auction - paper.

text.p: Three groups of investors are likely to participate in the privatization auction of Rio de Janeiro state power utility Cerj on November 20, O Globo newspaper said.
The first consortium includes Brazilian companies CSN and Light, France's Electricite de France (EDF) and U.S. firms Houston Industries and AES, the paper said.
O Globo also said Brazilian private bank Bradesco, construction firm Camargo Correa and cement group Votorantim are holding talks to join this group.
Another consortium comprises Brazilian firms Escelsa ESC.SAu, Iven, GTD Participacoes and U.S. Florida Power.
The third group includes Chile's Chilectra, Spain's Endesa and Portugal's Eletricidade de Portugal, the newspaper added.
The names of investors that have prequalified to participate in the auction will be announced on Friday, O Globo said.
Cerj's minimum price was set at 640 million reais, it added.
